# Wiele Properties

Wiele Properties is a Malta property-marketing and introductions platform under the Wiele Group brand, led by Jonathan Landman. Tagline: Malta Property. Global Ambition. Focus: investment real estate in Malta, welcoming local and international buyers, first-time and experienced investors, consortiums and property owners. Property interests include apartments, luxury apartments, residences and portfolios. Wiele does not offer letting, property management or fund management. Rental-income analysis distinguishes actual, contracted and projected income; returns are not guaranteed. Sales documentation is handled by appropriately licensed practitioners.

There are currently no advertised properties. Location photographs are not properties offered for sale.
